title: GH700 publication-authority closed wire

publication_lease_authorization.key_binding: signing_key_id and signing_key_material_id byte-equal the active manifest-pinned authorization verification key

append_authorization.key_binding: signing_key_id and signing_key_material_id byte-equal the active manifest-pinned authorization verification key

delivery_authorization.key_binding: signing_key_id and signing_key_material_id byte-equal the active manifest-pinned authorization verification key

ledger_append_authorization.key_binding: signing_key_id and signing_key_material_id byte-equal the active manifest-pinned authorization verification key

x-gh700-digest-framing: digest = lowercase sha256:<64hex> of SHA256(JCS({v:domain,...preimage_fields})); callers may not supply v

authorization_signing_preimage_digest.preimage: authorization preimage_fields from the selected closed branch

response_digest.preimage: response fields without response_digest plus response_nonce_digest

nonce.x-gh700-semantic: decode exactly 32 bytes, then require byte-identical unpadded base64url re-encode

signature_b64u.x-gh700-semantic: decode exactly 64 bytes, then require byte-identical unpadded base64url re-encode

uint64.x-gh700-semantic: JSON integers are 0..9007199254740991; decimal strings are 9007199254740992..18446744073709551615 after canonical parse

capsule_source.x-gh700-semantic: source_request_id=SHA256(JCS domain GH700:capsule-source-request-id:v1 over exact source_method/source_operation_id/secret_slot_id branch

deployment_manifest.x-gh700-policy-branch: deployment_policy only; prebootstrap_policy_binding is forbidden from persisted history deployment manifests
